Why the key is missing: in converter/build/keys.py:188, ALT_HINT = r"\b(or|short form|works too|both answers)\b" matches the word "or" that joins the two blank values, and parse_fill (keys.py:224-225) then returns todo('the key lists alternatives'). One caveat: the web form (tools/qa/resolve-input/ch17-ch18.md:34, and FillBlank.tsx has no width handling) shows "_____ or _____" with equal widths.
